title: Data Listing
description: An invoice table with search, filters, status, row actions and pagination that stays usable on a narrow screen.
summary: A real data table with filters, status and a scroll strategy.
notes: Search, filters, row selection and pagination are illustrative. Wire them to your own query and routing layer.
Below 48rem the issue date column is hidden; the remaining columns scroll horizontally inside .table-wrap.
Invoice numbers, clients and amounts are sample data.
